summary: SIEM contractual deliverable: chain-of-custody export + legal-preservation staging plan
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requests a contractually obligated SIEM export and verified chain-of-custody manifest required for a legal preservation order. Deliverable needs to include: chronological event export (ndjson), tamper-evident batch manifests (HMAC per-batch), RFC3161 timestamp attestation for the archive, and an escrow staging plan with transfer checklist.

Impact:
GreenRiver Bank has a pending legal hold and requires evidence handed to their E-Discovery team within the SLA window. Delay risks regulatory escalation and breach of contract.

Requested deliverables (customer-specified):
- Hourly NDJSON export covering 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 with header metadata retained and tenant IDs pseudonymized per contract.
- Per-batch HMAC manifest signed with Redwood rotation key, plus root checksum.
- RFC3161 timestamper receipt for the archive object.
- Transfer checklist and chain-of-custody PDF that documents who accessed the archive, when it was generated, and transfer method (SFTP to escrow or presigned S3 object with Object Lock).
- Confirmation of data retention hold override and a statement of non-deletion for the preserved slice.

Deadline: customer requests material delivery inside SLA (2026-03-14).
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - not a software bug. Customer request for export/packaging and legal-preservation artifacts.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-10: Initial triage by Support (Aisha). Identified contractual clauses requiring Object Lock and RFC3161 stamp.
2026-03-10: Opened INT-8842 to reserve temporary elevated retention and request SRE support for RFC3161 integration.
2026-03-11: SRE (Markus) validated that hourly NDJSON export job can be scoped by time range and tenant; confirmed existing export produces per-batch sequence numbers.
2026-03-11: Discovered current HMAC manifest code uses per-batch SHA256 but lacks a customer-visible rotation manifest. Proposed adding a rotation manifest and root checksum.
2026-03-12: Legal/Compliance asked for explicit chain-of-custody template showing generation node, operator account, and KMS key id. Need confirmation from Security on KMS key exportability for escrow.
Action items:
- Implement per-archive RFC3161 stamping step in export pipeline (blocked on time cert config).
- Produce sample export for customer verification (non-production data slice) by 2026-03-12.
- Prepare Object Lock + presigned transfer plan with expiration and escrow instructions.
comments: GreenRiver E-Discovery (2026-03-10): We need the archive and manifest in a forensically sound format. Please include a clear chain-of-custody PDF we can present to counsel.
Aisha Khan (Support) 2026-03-10: Thanks — we're triaging. I've opened INT-8842 to coordinate retention override and SRE involvement. Will confirm scope and timeline by EOD tomorrow.
Markus Lee (SRE) 2026-03-11: Validated export job; can produce hourly ndjson and create HMAC per batch. Need Security to confirm use of key-id 'kms-prod-03' for manifest signing.
Eve Martin (Security) 2026-03-11: kms-prod-03 is non-exportable. For escrow we recommend generating a short-lived escrow keypair and recording KMS attestations instead of exporting the master key.

Aisha Khan (Support) 2026-03-12: Sent customer a sample NDJSON slice and example HMAC manifest for review (redacted). Awaiting confirmation on RFC3161 stamp availability and whether escrow will accept Object Lock presigned S3 or prefer SFTP pull.
resolution:
Workaround provided: shared a redacted sample export and HMAC manifest along with a draft chain-of-custody PDF for legal review. Planned next steps: finalize RFC3161 stamping config and run a full production-scoped export for the date range 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 on 2026-03-13. Delivery method agreed: presigned Object Lock S3 object to customer escrow bucket with 90-day retention and transfer manifest. Post-delivery: schedule a compliance review call and produce signed acceptance email.
Status: In Progress — export scheduled 2026-03-13, RFC3161 pending cert configuration.
